sections.title: Signature
sections.description: Only the configured algorithm is accepted, so a token cannot choose its own. HS256 verifies a shared secret; RS256 and ES256 a public key or the issuer's key set.

sections.title: Issuer and claims
sections.description: Every token must carry this issuer exactly. The identity comes from the username claim and is presented with the prefix; the token then has to agree with the MQTT username.

sections.title: Groups
sections.description: One 'claim value => existing XMQ group' per line. Empty passes the claim values through as group names, and native Permissions fail closed for a token that maps to nothing.

sections.title: Token checks and cache
sections.description: exp is required. A verified token is remembered for the positive lifetime, a refusal for the negative one; an unavailable key set is never remembered.
